field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Actual executable local model identities; this audit invokes none.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Name expected, observed, pass state and principle for each check.
field_principles.causal_intervention_rows: Record expected and observed outcomes for all invalid development copies.
field_principles.cold_replay_parity: Retain every prediction and state mismatch, not aggregate agreement.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Record the real UTC terminal decision time.
field_principles.duration_s: Use measured monotonic time and disjoint phase spans.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host is host; no device execution occurs.
field_principles.experiment_id: Bind the result to the active experiment task.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here while consumer values remain ordinary top-level values.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Name the exact upstream field for every blocked verdict.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Complete findings start complete_; external absence starts blocked_.
field_principles.independent_interval_rows: Retain per-comparison and per-stratum paired stream intervals.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for the actual CPU replay.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the actual no-LLM class without padding time.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted, completed and failed loads and generations.
field_principles.mixture_audit_complete_score: One records complete replay and adversarial controls regardless of efficacy.
field_principles.mixture_promotion_score: One requires every efficacy, recurrence, causality, feedback and memory gate.
field_principles.model_invoked: True for any attempted model load or generation; this audit performs none.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Hash actual inputs, authority boundaries, resource ownership and failed checks.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze development, evaluation and bootstrap seeds before outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, config, inputs and immutable raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Keep every arm and stream with metrics, cost, error, abstention and censoring.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260914, real UTC start/end and monotonic timing.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: State planned, attempted, complete and censored units with the stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the artifact; retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Keep producer identities, terminal classes, retirement and quarantine state.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the real UTC invocation start.
field_principles.status: Use a terminal complete or blocked record; unfinished work belongs in checkpoints.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain command, exit code, elapsed time and log hash, including failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed terminal class set; oracle authority forbids positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose exact evaluator authority; mechanics are not learned correctness.
